## Activity

During February 2025, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 375 captures. This activity provides the basis for the month’s image-quality and grading review. The recorded volume reflects all captures completed at the site during the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 23 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.1. These images could not be used for grading and are therefore recorded separately from images that produced a grading outcome. The result should be monitored alongside future activity to identify any change in image quality at West Gate Eye Clinic.

## Grading

A total of 100 results were recorded as referable. The median grading lag was 2. This indicates the typical interval between capture and completion of grading for the reporting period. Activity, image quality and grading results should continue to be reviewed together to support routine operational oversight at the site.
